name: Fractions of a quantity
definition: Taking a fraction of an amount means splitting it into equal parts and keeping some of them. Two thirds of 12 is 8 because 12 splits into three fours and you keep two of them. The trouble is always keeping straight what the whole is.
recognizeWhen: half of what is left over
two thirds of the students chose
a fraction of a group is then split again
the rest of the pizza was shared
misconceptions: I took the fraction of the original amount when it meant a fraction of what remained.
I found one third and stopped, instead of taking the two thirds the question asked for.
I added the two fractions' bottom numbers together.
